title: T-0.1: core module and purity gate
description:
Phase 0 task T-0.1 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). Build the DOM-free core module inside the plugin at plugins/beads-ui/core with its purity gate, plus the root monorepo bootstrap it needs (npm workspaces, package-lock.json, turbo.json, biome.json, tsconfig.base.json with the @beads-ui/core path alias).

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When plugins/beads-ui/core is built, the system shall compile under a tsconfig with "lib": ["es2023"] and "types": [] and shall emit no error.
- If any file in plugins/beads-ui/core references setTimeout, setInterval, queueMicrotask, requestAnimationFrame, window, document, process or a Node built-in, then the lint gate shall fail naming the file and line.
- When plugins/beads-ui/package.json is read, the system shall find no runtime dependencies.
- When claude plugin test runs an import probe, a hooks module importing a core file by relative path and a Client module importing a sibling file shall both load; if either is refused, then the probe shall fail naming the import.

Done when: the four ACs hold on beads-ui main, with tests plugins/beads-ui/core/test/purity.test.ts and parsers.test.ts. The import-probe AC needs Claude Code 2.1.299 or later; this host runs 2.1.296.

title: T-0.2: bd-node adapter
description:
Phase 0 task T-0.2 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). Build packages/bd-node, the Node adapter that runs bd --json for the web and MCP servers and maps its output onto the core's Issue model.

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When the adapter runs bd list --json against a store, the system shall return Issue objects whose fields match the core's Issue model for every record.
- If bd exits 13 on a guarded update, then the adapter shall return a typed StaleWrite result and shall not retry.
- If bd is not on PATH, then the adapter shall fail with a message naming the binary and the install page, not a stack trace.

Done when: the three ACs hold on beads-ui main, tested in packages/bd-node/test/bd-adapter.test.ts.

title: T-0.3: mod plugin and marketplace
description:
Phase 0 task T-0.3 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). The mod plugin at plugins/beads-ui (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json, hooks/register.ts with a hello pane) and the root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json listing ./plugins/beads-ui, with the validate allow-list in the pre-commit gate.

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When claude plugin validate --json runs on plugins/beads-ui, the system shall list only the hooks and calls in the committed allow-list, every $ call shall sit in the hooks module's own files, and the pre-commit gate shall fail on any difference.
- When claude plugin validate . runs on the repository root, the marketplace shall validate and shall list ./plugins/beads-ui.
- When claude plugin test runs, the hello pane's render test shall pass on the terminal and desktop surfaces.
- If any file in plugins/beads-ui exceeds 1 MB, then the pre-commit gate shall fail naming it.

Done when: the four ACs hold on beads-ui main. Floor Claude Code 2.1.299; this host runs 2.1.296.

title: T-0.4: repository hygiene for a public repo
description:
Phase 0 task T-0.4 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). Repository hygiene for a public repo: gitleaks in pre-commit, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, and a README layout section. Founding ask: "just note that its public and open source so shouldn't have any secrets or sensitive stuff".

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When a commit is attempted, the gitleaks pre-commit hook shall scan it, and if a secret pattern matches then the commit shall be refused.
- When README.md describes the layout, it shall name the shared layers as data access, domain logic, view models, commands and design tokens, and shall not name layout.

Done when: both ACs hold on beads-ui main.

title: T-1.1: Board tab with keyboard Move to
description:
Phase 1 (MVP) task T-1.1 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). The Board tab of the /beads pane in the Claude Code mod. Founding ask: "i want to be able to drag and move tasks, reaarrange, reorder, sort, see kanban board"; the MVP moves cards by keyboard (D-3, D-8), drag is Phase 2.

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When the pane opens, the system shall render one column per status returned by bd statuses, ordered by category active, wip, frozen, done, each with its issue count.
- When the user picks a status in a card's Move to control, the system shall run bd update <id> --status <new> --if-status <shown>, and if bd exits 13 then the system shall restore the card to its shown column, show a conflict line and refresh that issue.
- While the swimlane selector is set to assignee, the system shall render one row per distinct assignee plus an unassigned row.
- If bd list fails or times out, then the system shall keep the last rendered board, show an error line with the exit code, and retry on the next refresh.

Done when: the four ACs hold on beads-ui main with tests (core/test/columns, views; hooks/pane.test.ts).

title: T-1.2: Backlog tab with sort and filter
description:
Phase 1 (MVP) task T-1.2 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). The Backlog tab of the /beads pane. Founding ask names "sort" and "backlog".

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When the Backlog tab renders, the system shall list open issues sorted by priority then created date and shall honour the filter expression's type, label, assignee and ready predicates.
- When the user enters a filter with an unknown key, the system shall show the accepted keys and shall not change the list.

Done when: both ACs hold on beads-ui main with tests (core/test/sort, filter, views).

title: T-1.3: Detail tab and inline edit
description:
Phase 1 (MVP) task T-1.3 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). The Detail tab with inline edit. Founding ask: "update and create /beads-task(s)".

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When a card's detail is opened, the system shall show every field in the Data Model's Issue type that the store returned, the dependencies with their statuses, and the last ten events from bd history --events.
- When a field is edited and submitted, the system shall write it with bd update and shall re-read the issue before redrawing.

Done when: both ACs hold on beads-ui main with tests (core/test/views, hooks/pane.test.ts).

title: T-1.4: quick-add and display-id minting
description:
Phase 1 (MVP) task T-1.4 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). Quick-add with the D-23 grammar and D-9 display-id minting. Founding ask: "update and create /beads-task(s)".

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When the user submits a quick-add line, the system shall parse title, p0 to p4, type:, @assignee, +label, due: and sprint: tokens and shall create the issue with the matching bd create flags.
- While the store's existing issues carry metadata.display_id and id_policy is auto or fleet-slug, when an issue is created the system shall mint a display id of the form PREFIX-<title-slug>-<4 random lowercase alphanumerics> and shall write metadata.display_id and the id:<display_id> label.
- If id_policy is off, then the system shall create the issue without touching metadata.display_id or labels.

Done when: the three ACs hold on beads-ui main with tests (core/test/quickadd, with a fixture pinning the slug shape against ids bd-new minted in this store, per D-9).

title: T-1.5: delete confirmation flow
description:
Phase 1 (MVP) task T-1.5 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). The delete confirmation flow (D-13). Founding ask: "delete them (will have like an "are you sure?" double check page flow)".

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When the user chooses delete, the system shall open a focused pane showing bd delete <id> --dry-run output and a Close instead action before any destructive write.
- If the dry run lists dependents outside the selection, then the system shall require the display id typed into the confirmation Input before enabling Delete with --cascade.
- When Close instead is chosen, the system shall run bd close <id> and shall not run bd delete.

Done when: the three ACs hold on beads-ui main with tests (hooks/confirm.test.ts).

title: T-1.6: bands and the beads command
description:
Phase 1 (MVP) task T-1.6 of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md (approved 2026-10-21). The /beads command (alias bu per D-7 (a)) and the band above the prompt, plus docs/procedures/mod-install.md.

Acceptance criteria (verbatim from the design):
- When a session starts with the mod loaded, the system shall register /beads and shall draw a band with open, in-progress and blocked counts for the current repo's store, refreshed at most every 10 seconds.
- If the pane cannot be placed because the terminal is narrower than 110 columns and the user did not open it, then the system shall show a toast naming the width needed and shall not draw the pane.

Done when: both ACs hold on beads-ui main with tests (hooks/bands.test.ts), and mod-install.md gives the commands to load the mod.

The switch is a config file setting per machine profile in ai-harness, and the panel is retired one machine profile at a time. The code for the switch lands in ai-harness.

title: Integrate the autonomous task queue and its dashboard with beads-ui
description: Sergei, 2026-10-14: beads-ui should incorporate the autonomous CC-session work-queue system and its dashboard (ai-harness epic OPS-li9bg), merged or integrated with beads-ui. Where the queue system itself lives is open: ai-harness, ai-chassis, a separate package, or an optional import from ai-chassis. For now nothing moves: the queue stays where it is, and this task tracks the integration and the follow-up decision. ai-chassis still has to be open-sourced.

title: npm audit: 10 dev-only advisories under markdownlint-cli2
description:
`npm audit` on the beads-ui root reports 10 advisories (3 low, 7 high), all in the dev-only dependency tree of `markdownlint-cli2` (braces, js-yaml, katex, markdown-it), measured 2026-10-21 on branch wt/ops-vm-3/BU-t-0-1-core-module-gset at 588d3ec.

They predate the T-0.1 bootstrap: `markdownlint-cli2 ^0.21.0` was the root package.json's only devDependency at a9e6e45, and `npm ls` traces every flagged package to it. Bumping to the latest `markdownlint-cli2` (0.23.3) still reports 10 advisories, and the braces advisory lists every version as affected, so there is no upgrade that clears them.

All are denial-of-service class advisories in a local lint tool that never ships in the plugin (plugins/beads-ui has no dependencies). Options: npm `overrides` pinning patched js-yaml and markdown-it versions where they exist, dropping the npm copy in favour of the pre-commit hook's own markdownlint-cli2, or accepting them until upstream ships fixes.

Done when: the chosen option is applied and `npm audit` reports no high advisory, or the acceptance is recorded with its reason.
